Random rivers. Playing. Seed 123456. A random river network on a 113 by 64 grid, flowing left to right. Every cell drains to one of two neighbours downstream, so paths merge into rivers. Collatz delta. Playing. Seed 123456. Exactly 3,518 numbers reach 1 within 30 Collatz steps, the largest 1,073,741,824. The full drawing shows 1,297 of those numbers. 1 of 30 levels are fully drawn. Each path bends 10 degrees one way after an even step and 18 degrees the other way after an odd step, and all paths join one trunk at 1.
